subject: [ACTION] Finalize exec slate & offer framework for Q3 hires
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Executive headcount slate & offer framework

Team — attaching the consolidated exec slate (v3) and my recommended offer framework. Key points: 

- Goal: convert 3 prioritized exec roles (Head of Product, Head of Trust, Director, ML Ops) in Q3. Proposed start windows: Aug 15, Sep 1, Oct 3.
- Comp approach: target midpoint at 100% for Head roles with stretch equity for Head of Trust given scarcity. Director level pegged to 90–100% midpoint. See CompBand_Overlay_Exec_2027.pdf for band offsets.
- Budget ask: incremental monthly run-rate impact = $73k (salary + payroll tax) — finance signoff needed.
- Approval ask: green-light final offer ranges and signoff to proceed with verbal offers to shortlisted candidates by COB Jul 12.

Please review and reply with: APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGE + short rationale. Ill collect and compile for Vivek.

Attachments: Q3_executive_slate_v3.xlsx (roles + candidates), CompBand_Overlay_Exec_2027.pdf, Offer_Templates_v2.docx

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
VP, Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Executive headcount slate & offer framework

Olga — quick finance read. The $73k monthly incremental is plausible but I need a single-line justification for the equity uplift (Head of Trust) — how much additional dilution are we projecting? Also confirm whether the Director ML Ops role is backfilled or net new.

If both are net new, we should route this through the budget committee next week (Jul 14) for quarterly reforecast; otherwise we can approve on headcount runway.

Markus

Thanks, Olga. Quick clarifications from Comp & Rewards: 

- Head of Product: recommended cash range $225k–$265k, equity 0.5–0.8% total (4y vest, 1y cliff).
- Head of Trust: cash $235k–$280k, equity 0.7–1.1% total; given market, recommend front-loaded RSU tranche in year 1 for retention (suggest 30%).
- Director, ML Ops: cash $160k–$185k, equity 0.15–0.25%.

Ive attached CompBand_Overlay_Exec_2027.pdf with the band offsets and internal equivalent roles. We can flex at offer stage up to 7% above midpoint for sign-off by Vivek if competitive urgency is flagged.

Laura Bennett

- Negotiation playbook: we will use the flex up to 7% above midpoint rule for Head roles (CEO signoff required beyond that). For equity, margin of +0.15% beyond recommended top-of-band needs approval from Vivek.

All — thanks for the inputs. Ive reviewed the slate and comp overlays. Quick decisions: 

1) Approve proceeding with verbal offers for Head of Product & Head of Trust (ranges as Laura recommended).
2) Director, ML Ops: hold for final candidate callback — approve offers contingent on backfill status confirmation (Olga to confirm if truly net-new).
3) Finance: Markus, approve routing to budget committee with the $73k monthly note; if the committee asks for reforecast, I will present.

Action items: Olga to confirm backfill status for Director role and to share the two candidate profiles and proposed LOIs by Jul 14 COB. Sam (HireWell) to prepare LOIs. Laura to prepare the official offer language and details on the front-loaded RSU tranche.

Id like a single-thread decision log for audit — please reply here once each action completes.
